We really need to get those emojis in this server
Strongly against. Another case of lunchtable grudges.
Not specifically about this repeal, but the SC feels like a Taco Bell
My own commend looks positively radiant and original at this point
I’ll gladly take advantage of anyone who touched a delegate seat being commendable now but it still feels weird
Complaining about this is hypocritical given repeal condemn koth but you see that’s totally different
Changed the channel name: [AT VOTE] SC - Repeal "Condemn Tinfect"

https://forum.nationstates.net/viewtopic.php?p=42819315#p42819315 additional context on the nature of the OOC issues if anyone needs it. I can’t argue over the fact that Tinfect has done shitty things, and I agree with the desire to remove the badge. However, the repeal itself is grotesque and some parts are borderline nonsensical. I completely understand that weird stuff happens when you try to convert OOC issues into a legal IC format, and that this was likely tricky to put together, but then the approach should be openness about the real reasons for repealing and a longer forum period than 2 weeks, especially considering the primary author hasn’t done this in many years

This was clearly guaranteed to pass the moment it was posted, so why approach it in a way that generates unnecessary opposition and confusion from people who would otherwise support, like the author of the linked comment?
Man I miss Morover. His opinions had this purity that’s increasingly rare these days. Always called a spade a spade
Changed the channel name: [Concluded] SC - Repeal "Condemn Tinfect"
